caption: The video captures a bartender in a dark suit with a magenta pocket square standing behind a bar, holding a stainless-steel shaker tilted over a coupe glass. A large clear ice sphere rests inside the glass as a thin stream of reddish-amber liquid pours from the shaker's lip. The pour is already underway and continues without interruption, the stream falling steadily into the bowl. Across the action the shaker rotates gradually downward, its opening angling more steeply toward the glass while its lip moves slightly higher above the rim. The glass already holds a shallow pool of amber liquid around the lower part of the ice sphere. Several glass bottles fitted with metal pour spouts sit on the counter to the left and right, while a softly blurred wall of bottles fills the background. The coupe glass, the ice sphere, and the surrounding bottles hold their positions, indicating a static camera as the pouring action unfolds.
relations: Tilting the shaker downward sustains a thin amber stream falling steadily into the coupe glass bowl.
The continuous pour accumulates a shallow amber pool around the base of the stationary ice sphere.
As the shaker rotates, its lip rises slightly above the rim while the stream keeps flowing.
Static framing keeps the bottles and glass fixed while only the shaker's angle changes.
